inputs.prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Orthographic photograph, taken straight on, of precast concrete flags, 600 by 600 mm, stack bond, 6 mm grit joints, 1800 mm across, weathered by years of city street rain: walked-in grey, dark gum spots trodden flat, dirt gathered in the joints, faint scuff marks. Flat even overcast light with no shadows, no highlights and no vignetting. The whole frame is the surface: no windows, no doors, no signs, no text, no people, no sky, no horizon.

reasons.components.base: Z-Image, Apache-2.0 at a pinned revision, whose VAE is byte-identical to FLUX.1-schnell's Apache release (licence matrix section 12)
reasons.components.control: the Z-Image Fun union control 2.1, Apache-2.0, the full version rather than the deliberately weaker lite one
reasons.conditioning.edge: the recipe's joint and chip outlines from the same height map, a second control to compare against depth; encoding: white where height steps by 24 of 255 levels or more to a torus neighbour: the recipe's joint and chip outlines, exact and wrapping across the tile
reasons.container: the image this lane built from its committed recipe, pinned by digest
reasons.guardrails: these models ship no guardrail, and their only inputs are a committed texture set's own relief and a prompt written from the catalog, with no people and nothing personal
reasons.inputs: the set's own summary from its container header and its extent from the texture manifest, a weathering description in plain words, and the constraints that keep the picture a texture: flat light so no lighting is baked into a base colour, and nothing structural the recipe does not hold
reasons.sampler.guidance_milli: 4.0, the guidance VideoX-Fun's Z-Image control example uses
reasons.sampler.name: the flow-match Euler scheduler the base repository ships and VideoX-Fun's own example selects
reasons.sampler.negative_prompt: a single space, which is what enables true classifier-free guidance in this pipeline without describing anything
reasons.sampler.steps: 25, the step count VideoX-Fun's Z-Image control example uses
reasons.sampler.tiling: the lane's tiling schedule: the latent grid and the control latents are rolled by a seeded offset each step and rolled back, because a transformer model has no convolution padding to make periodic
reasons.sampler.width: 1024, the published sets' own width, so the output needs no resampling to become a set
reasons.sampler.wrap_margin_px: 64 px, eight latent pixels of the neighbouring tile given to the VAE on each side and cropped after, so its convolutions see the tile's other edge instead of zeros
reasons.seed: seed index 2 of 4 by the job's seed rule: the first four bytes, big-endian, of sha256 of 'exulanica.appearance-seed/v1:<job>:<target>:<candidate>:<role>:<index>'
